title: Weak delocalization of a resolution at a minimal prime over the singular ideal
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $A$ an $R$-algebra of finite presentation, $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$ a homomorphism of $R$-algebras and $\mathfrak q\subset\Lambda$ a prime ideal, with $\mathfrak h_A=\sqrt{H_{A/R}\Lambda}$ as in [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution] ($H_{A/R}$ the singular ideal [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]). Let $\mathfrak p\subset R$ be the inverse image of $\mathfrak q$, $R_{\mathfrak p}$ and $\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ the localizations [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $A_{\mathfrak p}=A\otimes_RR_{\mathfrak p}$ (of finite presentation over $R_{\mathfrak p}$, with the induced map $A_{\mathfrak p}\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$). Assume that $\mathfrak q$ is minimal over $\mathfrak h_A$ and that $R_{\mathfrak p}\to A_{\mathfrak p}\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}\supset\mathfrak q\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ can be resolved [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution]. Then there is a factorization $A\xrightarrow{\beta}C\xrightarrow{\gamma}\Lambda$ of $\alpha$ by homomorphisms of $R$-algebras with $C$ of finite presentation over $R$ such that $H_{C/R}\Lambda\not\subset\mathfrak q$, where $H_{C/R}\Lambda$ is the ideal of $\Lambda$ generated by $\gamma(H_{C/R})$ (equivalently $\mathfrak h_C=\sqrt{H_{C/R}\Lambda}\not\subset\mathfrak q$).

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F9 (lemma-delocalize-weak, line 2148), Section 07F6 (section-local); reference Swan, Lemma 12.2, or Popescu GND, Lemma 2
